title: Rapid-reply sprint pocket pad — Kai
content:
Quick context / intent:
- 90-minute rapid reply block: clear hot follow-ups, voicemail blitz, 3 POA (proof-of-action) pushes to demo.
- Focus: low-friction re-engage -> demo conversions or schedule-to-demo.
- Metrics today: 12 dials, 8 emails, 3 demos scheduled (target).

Top priority call queue (A = highest) — scratch notes & next steps:
1) A - Lina Park | Fathom Health | VP Product | best: 9:30–10:15
   - Last touch: intro email + short case study (3/16). Opened twice.
   - Script bullets: reminder of 2 min ROI snapshot, ask for 15-min overview call, suggest Wed/Thu slots.
   - Objections to prep: "we already have an LLM vendor" -> emphasize latency/cost delta & private deployment option.
   - Next step: Call -> leave voicemail template (below) if no answer -> send 2-line SMS with calendar link.
   - [ ] dial 9:32am  (outcome: ______)

2) B - Miguel Soto | Retailly | Dir Eng | best: after 2pm
   - Last touch: demo request via AE intake (3/11), no reply.
   - Note: interested in dedicated capacity pricing. Needs SSO & SOC2 details.
   - Next step: Send tailored RFP snippet + ask quick budget range, book 20-min technical sync if ok.
   - [ ] email sent (time: ____), [ ] follow-up call 2:15pm

3) A - Claire Nguyen | LoopApps | Head of ML | lunchtime try 12:05
   - Got a follow-up from trial; ambiguous on integration timeline.
   - Quick wins to push: Redwood Optimize recommendations for embedding cost reduction (share quick bullets).
   - Next step: demo slot suggestion + share 1-pager on Optimize.
   - [ ] schedule 12:05 call

4) C - Trey Hudson | EduStack | AE inbound cold convert | flexible
   - Low ARR but fast close potential.
   - Next step: short intro, qualify budget & timeline, ask for pilot window.
   - [ ] quick qualify call 3pm

Voicemail + SMS templates (short, test 2 variants):
- VM template A (concise): "Hi {FirstName}, Kai from Redwood Inference — quick ROI note: we cut inference cost by ~30% for teams like yours without changing model. Wanted to share a 10-min snapshot and see if Thursday works. My number is XXX-XXX-XXXX. Thanks!"
- VM template B (value + hook): "{FirstName}, it’s Kai — we helped a product team shave 150ms off median chat latency and drop per-token spend. If that’s relevant, 10 minutes next week? Calendar: tinyurl.com/redwood-demo"
- SMS (two-line): "Hey {FirstName} — quick q: do you have 15 min this week to see how we cut inference cost & stabilize latency? Book: tinyurl.com/redwood-15"

Objection bank (short) — quick rebut bullets:
- "We already built this in-house" -> ask about SLOs & ops cost, mention Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput + managed fallbacks.
- "Pricing is too high" -> offer Optimize profile + batching/quant suggestions, propose pilot pricing.
- "Security/compliance concern" -> note Private (VPC/on-prem) + KMS/HSM integrations & audit logs.

Micro-play: Demo-to-trial fast path (3 steps)
1) 10-min overview -> highlight latency/cost wins + case study (Retailly).
2) 30-min technical sync -> model/infra questions, propose pilot config + SLA.
3) 2-week pilot -> measure latency, cost delta; checklist for success.

Follow-up email snippets (short) — pick fast:
- Email A (post-voicemail): "Hi {FirstName}, left a quick voicemail — we helped teams cut inference cost and improve median latency. Quick 15-min slot this week? [2 options]. — Kai"
- Email B (data-first): "Hi {FirstName}, saw your note about scaling chat. Quick stat: our customers see 20–40% cost/unit reductions after Optimize & prefix caching. If you want, I can share a short report specific to your stack. — Kai"

Workflow checklist during the block:
- [ ] Open CRM list: filter by "this-week: high intent" -> sort by last-touch
- [ ] Pull last email thread + 2 best artifacts to attach (case study + 1-pager)
- [ ] Dial sequence (3 attempts): call -> voicemail -> SMS -> email
- [ ] Log outcome in CRM within 15 min
- [ ] Add next step + remind time (native calendar invite)

Personal micro-notes (things to test today):
- Try voicemail template B first for execs, A for managers.
- Use "Optimize 1-pager" with Claire — attach before the call.
- Test subject line: "Quick note on inference costs + latency improvements" vs "15 min: reduce per-token spend" (A/B in email client).
- Time-box: if no reply within 48 hours, mark as nurture and switch cadence to biweekly.

Random quick scratches (brain dump):
- Add a Jira ticket to request updated SOC2 doc artifact from security: JIRA-SEC-401 (flag to Solutions Eng).
- Slack: ping @maya for Retailly case study PDF (thread: #case-studies).
- Follow-up template for pricing ask: include example sizing for 3 consumption tiers.

End-of-block reflection (fill after):
- Dials completed: ____ , Emails sent: ____ , Demos scheduled: ____
- Notes: what worked / adjustments for next block: ______

---
Tiny housekeeping: make sure to move any booked demo here -> shared calendar (team demos / redwood-demos). Keep this pad as my quick reference for next-run.
